target_customer: Teams from seed to Series B running AI agents in production
problem: AI agents fail silently (bad tool calls, lost context, loops) in ways observability tools and evals miss.
business_model: B2B SaaS monitoring with integrations (SOC 2 Type II)

founders.name: Jerry Zhang
education: Left USC to join YC (met co-founder at USC as freshman per launch post)

technical_complexity.rationale: Auditing traces against agent instructions with LLMs and building alerts and integrations is standard engineering with hard evaluation quality problems.

defensibility.rationale: Observability incumbents such as Langfuse and Arize could add similar features; trace data and fast iteration are the edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Observability consolidation reported in 2026 but no action against Lemma found.

market_need_then: Agents were moving into production in 2025 and teams reported tests passing while real use failed, per the funding coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated companies use the name Lemma (Thread AI product, an earlier YC company). No brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Lemma raised a 2.3 million dollar pre-seed in August 2026 after the Fall 2025 batch, backed by Matrix and others, with named customers such as Modus and Boardy. It is early with two founders and no exit found. Competition from established observability vendors is the key risk.
notes: Round date reported as 2026-08 (Dealroom 08-07, press 08-13, Pulse 2.0 08-19); month used. Dealroom and Techfundingnews both confirm 2.3M. Competitor search returned 2026 comparison pages (Langfuse, Arize, Braintrust are named in the funding and landscape snippets) with nothing dated at the batch, so list is empty.
